chunks: Anza's Solana program foundation: https://github.com/solana-program (program ecosystem libraries and examples) and https://github.com/solana-program/create-solana-program — the fastest way to start Solana program development. Source: https://github.com/solana-program/create-solana-program

Scaffold usage: `pnpm create solana-program`, or with npm `npm create solana-program@latest` (the @latest tag is required or npm may resolve a cached outdated version). First CLI arg sets program name and directory; a second arg allows a program name differing from the directory. Source: https://github.com/solana-program/create-solana-program

Scaffold options: `--org` (organization name), `--anchor` / `--shank` (framework), `--client js --client rust` (generated clients), `--no-clients`, `--default` (skip prompts), `--address` (reuse a program address instead of generating a keypair), `--solana 1.18` (pin version), `--force`. Existing Anchor programs migrate by scaffolding with `--anchor`, replacing the program folder, setting `[package.metadata.solana] program-id` in Cargo.toml, then `pnpm install && pnpm programs:build && pnpm generate`. Source: https://github.com/solana-program/create-solana-program

UZE lab: programs/uzd-payments is the UZD Solana program scaffold — intended instructions register_tag (treasury-multisig binds a verified UZD.money tag hash to a recipient), record_payroll (anchors a payroll run's settlement commitment/Merkle root; amounts stay in Aztec private notes), revoke_tag. No instruction moves funds by itself; all state changes require the treasury authority signer. Devnet first; no mainnet without audit and explicit approval. Source: UZE UZD repo programs/uzd-payments
